title: Posting, Allocation and Payoff Terms (Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing)
content:
These terms govern how a payment on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account posts and is applied, how early payoff is treated, and the autopay timing figures. They are identical on all six plans (Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12, Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18, Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60, Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 and Ridgeline Low-Payment 144).

| Term | Figure on every plan |
|---|---|
| Posting cutoff | 17:00 Eastern on a business day; a payment received after it posts on the next business day |
| Order in which a payment is applied | Fees, then interest, then principal |
| Money beyond the scheduled payment | Reduces principal and does not advance the next due date |
| Prepayment penalty for paying early or in full | 0.00 USD |
| Payoff quote validity | 10 calendar days |
| Autopay enrollment lead time | Autopay must be enrolled at least 5 calendar days before a due date to draw that payment |
| Autopay suspension | After 2 returned payments in any rolling 365 days |

## Points of reading

- The cutoff is stated in Eastern time and applies on business days.
- The allocation order is fixed: fees are satisfied before interest, and interest before principal.
- No plan charges anything for paying early or in full.

## Hypothetical timing cases

- A payment received at 16:59 Eastern on a business day is before the 17:00 cutoff; one received at 17:01 is after it.
- Autopay enrolled 5 calendar days before a due date meets the lead time for that due date; autopay enrolled 4 calendar days before it does not.
